title: "visualisation_exercise.qmd"

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
df <- tibble(
  x = c(1, 2, 1, 3),
  y = c(3, 4, 1, 6)
)
gt(df)
```

# clean_names() renames the columns = converts column names into a consistent format by replacing spaces and punctuation with underscores and converting everything to lower case

# One of the columns contains date information which needs to be reformatted - we do this using the mutate() function and the as_date() function. 
# The as_date() function converts values containing date information into R’s date format
# can create an extra column in a data frame using function mutate()


# to add a new column named x_plus_y with the value of x plus the value of y, using mutate():
```{r}
df <- df |>
  mutate(x_plus_y = x + y)

gt(df)
```

```{r}
locations <- read_csv("data/movebank_data.csv") |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(date = as_date(timestamp))
```

# Looking at the data frame and check that the data looks as expected:

```{r}
gt(head(locations))
```

# Identifying the columns containing the latitude and longitude data, using a unique identifier for each animal in the column (individual_local_identifier)

```{r}
loc_selected <- locations |> select(
  date,
  individual_local_identifier,
  location_long, location_lat
)

gt(head(loc_selected))
```

# Grouping the data by date and individual_local_identifier (can group by multiple factors by adding additional arguments to the group_by() function)

```{r}
loc_grouped <- loc_selected |>
  group_by(date, individual_local_identifier)
```

# Using the summarise function, calculate the median latitude and median longitude for each individual on each date. Add the argument na.rm = TRUE to allow NA values to be ignored:

```{r}
loc_sum <- loc_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Longitude = median(location_long, na.rm = TRUE),
    Latitude = median(location_lat, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(head(loc_sum))
```

# plot the scatter plots using ggplot() and geom_point() with longitude on the x axis and latitude on the y axis
# add map to the plot using annotation_borders() and coord_quickmap()


# the scatter plot
```{r}
ggplot(
  loc_sum,
  aes(
    x = Longitude,
    y = Latitude,
  )
) +
  geom_point()
```

# with annotation borders
```{r}
ggplot(
  loc_sum,
  aes(
    x = Longitude,
    y = Latitude,
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap()
```

# with axis limits
```{r}
min_lat <- loc_sum |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()

max_lat <- loc_sum |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()

min_lon <- loc_sum |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()

max_lon <- loc_sum |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()


ggplot(
  loc_sum,
  aes(
    x = Longitude,
    y = Latitude,
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  annotation_borders(
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  coord_quickmap(
    # as my data has a narrow y range I have used 0.2 instead of 2
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 0.2, max_lat + 0.2)
  )
```

# with colour added
```{r}
ggplot(
  loc_sum,
  aes(
    x = Longitude,
    y = Latitude,
    color = individual_local_identifier
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  annotation_borders(
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 0.2, max_lat + 0.2)
  )
```

# with title and axis labels
```{r}
ggplot(
  loc_sum,
  aes(
    x = Longitude,
    y = Latitude,
    color = individual_local_identifier
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  annotation_borders(
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 0.2, max_lat + 0.2)
  ) +
  ggtitle("Locations of individual Phoca vitulina") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# different appearance for visualistion of data
```{r}
ggplot(
  loc_sum,
  aes(
    x = Longitude,
    y = Latitude,
    color = individual_local_identifier
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  annotation_borders(
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 0.2, max_lat + 0.2)
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  ggtitle("Locations of individual Phoca vitulina") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
